limitations: The ordinal/offset table uses full-segment accounting including page CRC/directory/header; transaction run bytes are payload only and exclude a random-access directory and protection.
Static byte subtraction is not a working format or validated net output saving. Existing inline singleton pages are assumed retained; combined stage estimates are not independent experiments.
Cross-segment logical key duplication precedes prefix/Zstd compression; it cannot be subtracted from physical V8 bytes.
No production changes; no new codec implementation or performance claim in this follow-up.
